daily.summary: La présidente de la Banque centrale européenne appelle, dans un entretien à « Ouest-France », à « une réaction vigoureuse et rapide » des pays de la zone euro pour améliorer la productivité.

daily.title: Céline Dion makes historic Paris comeback, six years after last tour
daily.summary: Beloved French Canadian singer Céline Dion on Saturday returned to the stage after years battling a rare neurological disorder with a sell-out concert in an arena west of Paris. The 58-year-old appeared visibly moved as she opened her first full concert in six years to a crowd of around 30,000 people.

daily.title: France beats Germany to reach first women's World Cup basketball final
daily.summary: France beat Germany Saturday and made it through to the final of the women's basketball World Cup for the first time after a 86-64 victory. Gabby Williams top scored with 22 points for the Olympic silver medalists, who kept their unbeaten record at the tournament alive before Sunday's decider in Berlin.

daily.title: Germany: AfD leads in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania, Merz's CDU slumps to 7%

The result would mark the party's worst-ever showing in a regional election in Germany.

daily.summary: How should we envision the African city of tomorrow? A city adapted to population growth and climate change, and freed from a colonial past that is still very much present in some places. Africa’s first pan-African architecture biennale, held this week in Kenya, is seeking to answer that question.

daily.title: Houthis seize key sites around Bab el-Mandeb as Saudi oil exports face disruption
daily.summary:
Saudi Arabia has stopped transferring oil through a major pipeline after it was attacked by drones.

Meanwhile, Houthi forces have taken control of a strategic port and island in Bab el-Mandeb from Yemeni government forces.

Iran, which backs the rebels, says it had nothing to do with the attacks.
